description: Average the season-to-date win counts over standings entries whose season-to-date points are more than 1.

a.request: Across all driver standings entries where the driver's season-to-date points total is more than 1, what is the average season-to-date number of wins (ignoring missing values, unrounded)?
a.sql: SELECT AVG(wins) FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1

b.request: Compute the average of driverStandings.wins (season-to-date win count) across all driverStandings rows where driverStandings.points (season-to-date points) is strictly greater than 1, excluding rows with missing wins values and without rounding the result.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(wins) FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1 AND wins IS NOT NULL
b.raw: Compute the average of driverStandings.wins (season-to-date win count) across all driverStandings rows where driverStandings.points (season-to-date points) is strictly greater than 1, excluding rows with missing wins values and without rounding the result.

c.request: Among driver standings entries where the driver has upwards of 1 point so far that season, what is the average season-to-date win count? Ignore missing values and don't round. Average the season-to-date win counts over standings entries whose season-to-date points are more than 1.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(wins) FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1 AND wins IS NOT NULL

d.request: Average the wins value (season-to-date win count) across driverStandings rows where the season-to-date points are greater than 1, excluding rows with missing wins values and without rounding the result.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(wins) FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1 AND wins IS NOT NULL
